caption: The drawing depicts a single bird, rendered in shades of brown, standing on what appears to be a brown tree stump. The bird features detailed line work to suggest feathers and texture, with intricate patterns on its wings and body, and it has a rounded body, short tail, and a small crest on its head. The bird’s beak is short and curved, and it has a small, round, dark eye. The legs of the bird are thin, straight, and also brown, blending into the overall color scheme. The tree stump is illustrated in multiple shades of brown, giving it a textured, wood-like appearance with lines and variations in tone to represent bark and grain. The background of the drawing is plain and white, with no additional objects or elements.
title: Little Wooden Hen
